title: Listening Section 1 - Photography Course Enquiry
instruction: You will hear a telephone conversation between a woman and a receptionist at an arts centre. Answer Questions 1-10.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Good morning, Riverside Community Arts Centre. Tom speaking.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: Hello. I saw your poster for the weekend photography course and I'd like to find out a bit more.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Of course. Can I take some details first? What's your name?

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: It's Maria Thornley.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Could you spell your surname for me?

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: Yes, it's T-H-O-R-N-L-E-Y.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Thank you. And a contact number?

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: My mobile is 07700 493826.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: 07700 493826. Got it. Now, the course starts on the twelfth of March, I think... sorry, let me check. No, I've got an updated timetable here. It's been moved back a week, so it starts on the nineteenth of March.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: That's fine, actually it's better for me.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Great. The fee is ninety-five pounds, but members of the centre get a discount. Are you a member?

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: Yes, I joined last year.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Then it's eighty-five pounds for you.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: Good. Is it held in the main hall?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: No, the main hall is being repainted, so the classes are in Room 14, on the first floor.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: Room 14. Okay. Do I need to bring my own equipment?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: You need your own camera, of course, and a tripod. We have a few spare ones, but there aren't many, so it's best to bring your own.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: I'll do that.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Can I ask what made you interested in the course? Is it for your work?

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: No, nothing like that, and I'm not planning any trips either. I was given a new camera as a birthday present last month and I'd really like to learn how to use it properly.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: That's a good reason to join.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: What will we be doing in the first session?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: The tutor, Dev, takes everyone into the old town to photograph buildings. People often expect landscapes, but we save those for the second weekend, and we don't do portraits on this course.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: How big are the classes?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Last year we had fifteen students, which was too many, so this year the limit is twelve.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: Lovely. And what happens on the last day?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: On the final day we put up an exhibition of everyone's best photographs in the cafe downstairs, and friends and family can come along. Some people expect a trip to a gallery, but that isn't possible this year, and feedback is given in person rather than online.

transcript.speaker: Maria
transcript.text: That sounds wonderful. Thank you for your help.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: You're welcome. See you on the nineteenth, then.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explanation: The surname is spelled out: T-H-O-R-N-L-E-Y.
Maria gives her mobile number as 07700 493826.
Tom first says the twelfth, then corrects it: the course has moved back a week and starts on the nineteenth.
The standard fee is 95 pounds, but Maria is a member so she pays 85 pounds.
The main hall is being repainted, so classes are in Room 14.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
